name: Kdenlive
tagline: A powerful free and open source cross-platform video editing program made by the KDE community. Feature rich and production ready.
description: Kdenlive is a powerful free and open source cross-platform video editing program made by the KDE community. Feature rich and production ready.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
services:
  app:
    image: linuxserver/kdenlive:423.08.5@sha256:4c908a8d2e43d788e37f7f1193014f5303b81f452942f26c46cb2a99d7db2d3b
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      PUID: $PUID
      PGID: $PGID
      TZ: $TZ
    ports:
      - target: 3000
        published: "${APP_PORT}"
        protocol: tcp
      - target: 3001
        published: 3001
        protocol: tcp
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/config
        target: /config
